question: Abhinandan Saroja National Award was started on the birthday of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Bhushan Saroja Vaidyanathan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Abhinandan Saroja National Award:-**

 
 
• **The Abhinandan Saroja National Award was begun on the birthday of the legendary Guru Smt. Padma Bhushan Saroja Vaidyanathan.**
 
• It is given for for commending the heritage in the field of Indian Classical Dance. 
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan Saroja Vaidyanathan:-**
 
 
• She is an Indian Bharatanatyam dancer, choreographer, and guru.
 
• She was conferred the Padma Shri in 2002 and the Padma Bhushan in 2013 by the Government of India.
